activity.notes: Patrick Buchan-Hepburn, 1st Baron Hailes, was the only Governor-General of the West Indies Federation, serving from the federation's establishment on 3 January 1958 until its dissolution on 31 May 1962. He represented Elizabeth II and held substantial executive authority under the federation's constitution.

sources.title: Governor-General of the West Indies Federation — office chronology
